text_block_list.text:
Break is over and I'm on my way back to
the
office, when...

...I was working out, and before I knew
it, the sun
came up. That's all.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: Yawn... ...Maybe I'll go up to the roof, and... catch some shut-eye...
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
It appears that Нарита Брайан was losing
sleep
during the break rather than
resting up...
